mapper.sql: p.sitecode, p.postcode, p.slug, p.category, p.coverimg, p.author, p.publishstatus, p.publishtime, p.sortnum, p.remark, p.createuser, p.createtime, p.updateuser, p.updatetime
order by p.sortnum, p.publishtime desc, p.postcode desc
mapper.select: select count(*) from u_s_post p inner join u_s_post_lang l on l.postcode = p.postcode and l.lang = #{lang}

select , l.title as title, l.summary as summary, l.content as content, l.keywords as keywords from u_s_post p inner join u_s_post_lang l on l.postcode = p.postcode and l.lang = #{lang} where p.slug = #{slug} and p.publishstatus = '已发布' and l.title is not null and trim(l.title) != '' limit 1
select l.lang from u_s_post_lang l where l.postcode = #{postCode} and l.title is not null and trim(l.title) != '' order by l.lang
select distinct p.category from u_s_post p where p.publishstatus = '已发布' and p.category is not null and trim(p.category) != '' order by p.category

select p.sitecode, p.postcode, p.slug, p.publishtime, p.sortnum, group_concat(l.lang order by l.lang) as langcodes from u_s_post p left join u_s_post_lang l on l.postcode = p.postcode and l.title is not null and trim(l.title) != '' where p.publishstatus = '已发布' group by p.sitecode, p.postcode, p.slug, p.publishtime, p.sortnum having langcodes is not null order by p.sortnum, p.publishtime desc, p.postcode desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_post( sitecode, postcode, slug, category, coverimg, author, publishstatus, publishtime, sortnum, remark, createuser, createtime, updateuser, updatetime ) values( #{siteCode}, #{postCode}, #{slug}, #{category}, #{coverImg}, #{author}, #{publishStatus}, #{publishTime}, coalesce(#{sortNum}, 0), #{remark}, #{createUser}, sysdate(), #{updateUser}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update u_s_post set slug = #{slug}, category = #{category}, coverimg = #{coverImg}, author = #{author}, publishstatus = #{publishStatus}, publishtime = coalesce(#{publishTime}, publishtime), sortnum = coalesce(#{sortNum}, 0), remark = #{remark}, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where postcode = #{postCode}

update u_s_post set publishstatus = #{publishStatus}, publishtime = case when #{publishTime} is not null and publishtime is null then #{publishTime} else publishtime end, updateuser = #{updateUser}, updatetime = sysdate() where postcode in
#{code}
mapper.select: select postcode, lang, title, summary, content, keywords from u_s_post_lang where postcode = #{postCode} order by lang
mapper.insert: insert into u_s_post_lang(postcode, lang, title, summary, content, keywords, createtime, updatetime) values(#{postCode}, #{lang}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{keywords}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update title = values(title), summary = values(summary), content = values(content), keywords = values(keywords), updatetime = sysdate()
